versions.changelog:
Initial release of Chinese LLM Router.

- Unified interface to access all major Chinese LLMs in OpenClaw.
- Supports model selection, comparison, recommendations, and testing via commands.
- Auto-fallback, cost tracking, and smart routing between multiple providers.
- Simple configuration with OpenAI-compatible APIs and quick setup script.
- Comprehensive model/task recommendations and up-to-date pricing included.
